item.title: Grayson Co. SO looking for Caneyville man wanted for felony strangulation, other violent acts
item.description: The Grayson Conty Sheriff’s Office is searching for a man with a history of violence who is currently wanted on felony strangulation, assault and unlawful imprisonment charges. Police are looking for 30-year-old William Austin Finn, of Caneyville.

item.title: Caneyville man wanted on felony strangulation, other charges, surrenders to GCSO
item.description: A Caneyville man wanted by the Grayson County Sheriff’s Office has surrendered to authorities. On Monday afternoon, the Grayson County Sheriff’s Office said in a social media post that deputies were looking for 30-year-old William Austin Finn.
